caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a man standing on a rectangular platform. The man is wearing a red hat with a checkered band, a red jacket with yellow shoulder decorations, and a blue and yellow vest underneath. There is a gray sash draped over his left shoulder, crossing his chest, and tied around his waist. He has a red apron-like cloth with a textured pattern in front, covering a green kilt with yellow fringes. His legs are covered with argyle-patterned socks in red, white, and blue, and he wears black shoes with decorative buckles. The figure has sideburns, and his left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand closed, while his right arm is raised with the hand partially open. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the colored figure in the center.
title: Tradesman's Sign: Highlander
